high_level_description: The image depicts two men standing outdoors under a makeshift shelter with a corrugated metal roof supported by metal poles. The setting appears to be a work area or a storage yard, as there are stacks of cardboard boxes and what looks like bags of grain or similar materials on the right side. The man on the left is wearing a blue t-shirt and has a beard. He is holding a smartphone in his hands and appears to be showing something on the screen to the other man. The man on the right is wearing a white shirt and glasses.
